none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives on a real separable Hilbert space, permitting nonconvexity, with L-Lipschitz gradients and f(x0)−inf f≤Δ. Parameters satisfy L>0 and Δ≥0; attainment of the infimum is unnecessary.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: Params; spec.valid; spec.admissible gradient and initial-gap conditions.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call at a chosen pair (x,y) returns (g(x,ω),g(y,ω)) using the same sample. Samples are IID across calls, and E[g(x,ω)]=∇f(x). Each paired reply counts as one oracle call. All Params, including L,M,ν,σ,Δ,ε,x0, are public; f,g and the sampling laws are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.Public, publicInput, Query, Reply and admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: Centered noise differences satisfy E‖(g(x,ω)−g(y,ω))−(∇f(x)−∇f(y))‖²≤M‖x−y‖^(2ν), where M≥0 and 0<ν≤1. This controls shared-sample noise increments separately from objective smoothness.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.valid and final two conditions of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform finite variance E‖g(x,ω)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ², with σ≥0. No higher-moment or exponential-tail bound is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible variance integrability and bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology; finite dimension is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: Params.normedE, innerE, completeE, measurableE, borelE and countableE.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return an E-valued measurable output X with integrable gradient norm and E‖∇f(X)‖≤ε, where ε>0. The criterion uses the unsquared norm.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over the algorithm's randomness and the IID oracle stream, under a fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The standard smooth nonconvex stationarity problem is augmented with shared-sample paired queries and a separate mean-square Hölder condition on centered noise increments throughout 0<ν≤1.
